s: Din beraka acharona al perot, ubo b' seipim: al perot hailan, chutz meHashem minim sheyyitbaer besiman r"ch, veal kol perot adama viraqot, vekol dabar sheen giddulo min haaretz — mebarek leacharehem "bore nepashot rabbot". Veim akal keshiur mikkol min vamin mimminim ellu — mebarek leacharehem beraka achat, kevan shebbirkatam shava. Vehu haddin im akal veshata. Uberaka zo chotem bah belo shem, sheomer: "baruk che haolamim", lepi sheyyesh omerim shettiqqenu bah chatima, veyesh omerim shello tiqqenu, ella hu matbea qatzar:

"Vechesronan", hu milleshon "kol machsoreka alai", kelomar tzorke sippuqan, shehem chaserim utzerikim lahem letzorek qiyyum chayyutam, shei epshar lahem lehitqayyem zulatam, kegon lechem umayim. Ve"al kol mah shebbarata lehachayot bahem", hem shear haddebarim shebberaam lehitanneg bahem, kegon mine perot. Veyesh omerim, she"chesronan" hu dabuq le"al kol mah shebbarata", kelomar shehem chaserim utzerikim le"kol mah shebbarata lehachayot ku'". Tzarik lomar "che" betzere"y: hasimanim hachasarim la nadapasv batok hsh"a maolam vakal mabaqasham yamatzam [laqaman] batok sadar barakat hanahanin maharab hamachabar ztzlh"h.
